div.p: This case-sensitive code system https://awatson1978.github.io/aerospace-medicine-ig/CodeSystem/space-procedure-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Crewed activity outside the pressurized volume of a spacecraft or habitat
Controlled reduction of cabin or airlock pressure
Controlled restoration of cabin or airlock pressure

description.value: Operational procedures performed in spaceflight that have no SNOMED CT equivalent
